title: ByteBeasts
tagline: ByteBeasts combines NFT collection with the fun of an on-chain RPG game. Each ByteBeast is a unique NFT, and there are five types: Crystal, Draconic, Shadow, Light, and Titanium, each with different strategic advantages.
description:
ByteBeasts offers an innovative blend of NFT technology and engaging gameplay, promising a unique and immersive experience for all players. Get ready to dive into the world of ByteBeasts, where every battle, trade, and story enhances your journey in the Starknet ecosystem.

Features:
Battles and Ranking:
- Engage in epic battles against formidable game bosses or challenge other players in the multiplayer arena.
- Level up your ByteBeasts and climb the rankings to win exciting prizes.
In-game Economy:
- Participate in a dynamic NFT marketplace within the Starknet ecosystem.
- Trade, buy, or sell your ByteBeasts to enhance your collection and strategic options.
Game Narrative:
- Explore the captivating story of ByteBeasts, discovering the mystical origins of these creatures.
- Experience a world where ByteBeasts are born from the magical energy of the Nexus and evolve through intense battles.
Game Design:
- Enjoy a visually appealing experience that combines medieval and digital styles.
- Immerse yourself in a world designed to captivate and engage players visually and strategically.
how_its_made:
Unity: Allows us to create visually appealing mobile experiences.
Starknet: Enables a fully on-chain scalable game that can leverage account abstraction for a smooth and enjoyable mobile experience.
Dojo Engine: An open-source framework for building autonomous, composable, and extensible games and worlds. It allows us to create a scalable and modular game.
